subject: design/feature-draft-readiness
statement: Count a requirement ruling only when its declared author is the operator or Argus with a mainline rule-acceptance grant; require an explicit operator ruling for a declined blocking finding.
intent: Prevent an engineering agent or ungranted Argus from silently closing a product problem or blocking review finding.
rationale: Readiness checks declared authorship against the pinned Argus authority contract, leaves a refused problem unanswered, and presents its requirement edit as unruled. The operator later vouches for declared authorship by approving the exact lock request.
fit_criterion: Operator and granted Argus rulings pass; ungranted, revoked, malformed, and other-agent rulings fail with the problem open and change unruled; blocking declines need an operator author and substantive reason; race, lint, and coverage gates pass.
